Coding with agents is expensive. At Pedal, we use Claude for almost everything, and I do not have a way to manage cost without interrupting my work.

  • Session limits: I hit token limits mid-task.
  • Spend caps: I hit weekly and monthly caps.
  • Workarounds: I switch models, accounts and credit cards to keep working.

This week I analyzed my usage. Much of my budget goes to work that is, frankly, not client-facing: cleanup, QA, reminders and documentation. It is almost all rote.

I designed a game that encourages my agents to use free, open source models.
